## About this example
A flyer with its **pier** and its **pinnacle**: 31 blocks, part generated as a
circular arch and part drawn by hand against it.

*What it exercises.* The automatic joint recovery on an assembly that is
**not a single chain**. A chain has two free ends; this has three, because the
pinnacle branches off the top of the pier. The panel names the extra end and
says which members load the arch rather than belonging to the sequence that
carries the line, instead of inventing a cut.

*Why it is here.* It is the case that says what the software will not assert.
The geometry, the weights, the groups and the three-dimensional view all work;
what is refused is a single line of thrust through an assembly that does not
have one, and the reason is given in the panel's own words.
